title.en: An Act Amending Section 12 of Republic Act No. 7279, otherwise known as the Urban Development and Housing Act of 1992, and for other purposes

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2007/ra_9397_2007.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Separability Clause. - If any part or provision of this Act shall be held unconstitutional or invalid, other provision hereof that are not affected thereby shall continue to be in full force and effect.

Repealing Clause. - All laws, presidential decrees, executive orders, rules, regulations, or parts thereof which are not consistent with this Act, are hereby repealed, amended or modified accordingly.
Effectivity. - This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in at least two newspapers of general circulation.
